messages:
marie: FYI MedICenter POC (Android) failing during demo. Client throws JSON.parse 'Unexpected end of JSON input' then disconnects ~12s after connect. Can eng advise? cc @derek @sara

 derek: Do they route through an API gateway/CDN? paste client log + raw sse bytes.

 marie: Yes Apigee in the path. Client log:
```
E/SSE: JSON.parse Unexpected end of JSON input
E/SSE: last_chunk='{"note":"Patient follow'
```
 Raw SSE concat from client capture:
```
data: {"type":"note","payload":{"pt":7,"note":"Patient follow


data: up: labs ordered"}

```

 derek: JSON clearly split across chunk/event boundary. Likely gateway buffering or idle timeout. Check gateway logs for idle timeout and whether streaming is enabled.

 sara: Short checklist: 1) ensure `Content-Type: text/event-stream`, `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`; 2) disable response buffering / enable streaming on Apigee; 3) disable gzip/recompression for SSE route; 4) flush after each event on server; 5) emit an SSE comment heartbeat (e.g. `: hb

`) every N seconds where N < gateway idle timeout.

 marie: Gateway log snippet:
```
[2026-09-14T14:12:07Z] upstream idle timeout=15s, connection closed
```

 derek: Then heartbeat should be <=7s. Also set `X-Accel-Buffering: no` for nginx-style proxies. Client-side: aggregate event text until the double-newline event delimiter before JSON.parse.

 marie: Can Redwood temporarily inject heartbeats for this hosted demo?

 derek: We can push a short-lived demo patch to emit `: hb` every 6s and force flush for the tenant. I'll open an internal POC ticket.

 ops-bot: :rotating_light: POC-9990 created and assigned to eng-platform (tag: sse-heartbeat)

 marie: Joining their call in 10m to walk through Apigee streaming toggles and test the heartbeat patch. Will update here after test. :thumbsup:
